Subject: Acme POC - proposed evaluation plan and next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps for the POC we discussed: 

Summary of needs:
- Low-latency summarization and question-answering against customer support transcripts (~10k tokens/session).
- Vector search + reranking for KB articles with embeddings.
- SLA target: 95th pct latency < 450ms for streaming responses.

Proposed POC (3-week):
1) Week 0 (this week): sign SOW + sandbox access (Redwood provides dedicated test model and sample config).
2) Week 1: ingest sample transcripts, baseline QA & embeddings tests with our reference prompts.
3) Week 2: integrate streaming endpoint and run latency/throughput tests; measure cost per 1k tokens.
4) Week 3: run evaluation set (50 queries), measure accuracy, latency, and present go/no-go decision.

Success criteria (draft) — please review/confirm:
- Accuracy: >= 82% on the curated eval set (F1/ExactMatch blended metric).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 450ms for streaming endpoints with 16-token chunks.
- Cost: Model + infra cost < $0.12 per 1k tokens at expected load.

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (stub) — contains scope, timeline, and resource commitments.

Requested next steps:
- Alex: confirm SOW and sign-off on success criteria by EOD Fri 7/10.
- Priya: share dataset sample and access details for ingestion.
- We (Redwood): provide sandbox credentials and initial ingest scripts by Mon 7/13.

I'll loop Jordan and Dev on technical setup once we get the SOW sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Acme POC - Week 2 status, proposed success criteria update & sign-off request

Hi Alex / Priya — quick Week 2 check-in and a small update to the success criteria based on initial results.

What we ran this week:
- Streaming latency tests at expected concurrency (10 concurrent sessions). 95th pct = 520ms on current model/config.
- Prompt tuning improved accuracy to 81% on the eval subset.
- Cost estimate for the 50-query run (week 3): ~$5.10 total (~$0.10 per 1k tokens projected).

Proposed adjustment to criteria (we recommend):
- Accuracy: target >= 80% (relaxing from 82%) given expected noise in transcripts.
- Latency: target remains 95th pct <= 450ms but with a two-tier acceptance: critical (<=450ms) or acceptable with mitigation plan (<=550ms with agreed fallback).

Request: please confirm sign-off on the adjusted success criteria and confirm Sara as the POC owner so we can schedule the week 3 eval run for Thu 7/22.

If you approve, we'll run the full 50-query evaluation on Thu 7/22 and present results the same afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa
